-- Untrusted names must be a single plain file name inside notes:
-- no separators, no "..", not empty.
is_safe_name(name: str) -> bool =
  post not out or (name.char_count() > 0 and name.split("/").len() == 1 and name.split("\\").len() == 1 and name != ".." and name != ".")
  ex is_safe_name("notes.txt") == True
  ex is_safe_name("../secret") == False
  name.char_count() > 0 and name.split("/").len() == 1 and name.split("\\").len() == 1 and name != ".." and name != "."

-- True only when the name is safe and its file opens for reading
-- inside the notes directory.
can_read(name: str) -> bool uses fs =
  pre is_safe_name(name)
  let text = fs.read(name) else return False
  True

-- Counts the names that are readable files inside notes.
count_readable(names: List[str]) -> int uses fs =
  post out >= 0
  post out <= names.len()
  with fs = fs.sub("notes")
    var n = 0
    for name in names
      if is_safe_name(name) and can_read(name)
        n += 1
    n
